name: Bond's Brewing Company-Buffalo
old_description: At Bond’s Brewing Company, our standard beers offer a little something for everyone, ensuring that every guest finds a brew they love. Crafted with high-quality ingredients, each beer highlights our dedication to excellence and balance. We strive to keep these favorites on tap year-round, providing a consistent selection of well-crafted brews that you can count on for any occasion.
about:
Founded in 2019 in Laramie, Wyoming, Bond's Brewing Company began as a craft brewery focused on unique, high-quality beer and a welcoming community space. The founders, whose names are not publicly disclosed, built the business around the idea that beer is an experience that brings people together.

The company operates two taprooms—in Laramie and, since a 2023 expansion, in Buffalo—where it produces a rotating lineup of year-round standard beers and seasonal releases. At the Buffalo location, the menu also includes expertly crafted cocktails made from fresh ingredients such as clam juice, tomatoes, and pickle juice. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Bond's Brewing serves local residents and visitors directly through its taprooms, offering a range of styles from a light kolsch-style ale to a hop-forward pale ale and fruit-infused wheat beers. The beers carry names like Arrowhead Red, Rhuberry, and Citra-Hop-A-Dopolis, reflecting regional inspiration and ingredient-driven recipes.

The company emphasizes its dedication to innovation, quality, and community, describing its spaces as gathering places that contribute to Wyoming's growing craft beverage scene. It highlights its award-winning beer and the introduction of craft cocktails as key differentiators.
